ayahs.meta_en: The Prophet's Exemption from Absolute Time Knowledge
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ذ-ك-ر (dh-k-r): disclosing the temporal coordinates of the Hour.

english_translations.sahih_international: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
english_translations.pickthall: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Wherein art thou (concerned) with the declaration thereof?
english_translations.shakir: About what! You are one to remind of it.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), you do not know (when and how) it will come.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: You have no knowledge to say anything about it,
english_translations.arberry: What art thou about, to mention it?

ayahs.translation_bn: এ সংক্রান্ত জ্ঞান তোমার প্রতিপালক পর্যন্তই শেষ।
ayahs.translation_en: To your Lord is its finality.
ayahs.conventional_en: To your Lord is its finality.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তার শেষ পরিণতি তোমার রবের কাছেই।
ayahs.meta_bn: চরম জ্ঞানের সার্বভৌমত্ব: কিয়ামতের পরম সমাপ্তি কেবল রবের ইখতিয়ারে

ayahs.meta_en: The Sovereign Limit & Ultimate Termination with God
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ن-ه-ي (n-h-y): ultimate boundary and sovereign prerogative.

english_translations.sahih_international: To your Lord is its finality.
english_translations.pickthall: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: With thy Lord in the Limit fixed therefor.
english_translations.shakir: To your Lord is the goal of it.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: This matter is in the hands of your Lord.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: To your Lord belongs (the knowledge of) the term thereof?
english_translations.arberry: Unto thy Lord is the final end of it.

ayahs.translation_bn: যারা একে ভয় করে তুমি কেবল তাদের সতর্ককারী।
ayahs.translation_en: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
ayahs.conventional_en: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তুমি তো কেবল তাদের সতর্ককারী, যারা তা ভয় করে।
ayahs.meta_bn: The Prophetic Role: Warning the Receptive ও আল্লাহভীরুদের সতর্ক করাই রাসূলের দায়িত্ব

metadata.theme: The Prophetic Role: Warning the Receptive
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ن-ذ-ر (n-dh-r): forewarning that inspires ethical caution.

ayahs.meta_en: The Prophetic Role: Warning the Receptive
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ن-ذ-ر (n-dh-r): forewarning that inspires ethical caution.

english_translations.sahih_international: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
english_translations.pickthall: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Thou art but a Warner for such as fear it.
english_translations.shakir: You are only a warner to him who would fear it.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: You are only a warner for those who fear such a day.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: You (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) are only a warner for those who fear it,
english_translations.arberry: Thou art only the warner of him who fears it.

ayahs.transliteration: ka-annahum yawma yarawnahā lam yalbathū illā ʿashiyyatan aw ḍuḥāhā
ayahs.translation_bn: যেদিন তারা তা দেখবে সেদিন তাদের মনে হবে, যেন তারা (পৃথিবীতে) এক সন্ধ্যা বা এক সকালের বেশি অবস্থান করেনি।
ayahs.translation_en: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
ayahs.conventional_en: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
ayahs.conventional_bn: যেদিন তারা তা দেখবে, সেদিন তারা মনে করবে, তারা (দুনিয়ায়) একটি সন্ধ্যা বা একটি সকাল ছাড়া (অবস্থান) করেনি।
ayahs.meta_bn: The Fleeting Perception of Earthly Span ও কিয়ামতের তুলনায় পার্থিব জীবনের ক্ষণস্থায়িত্ব

metadata.theme: The Fleeting Perception of Earthly Span
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ع-ش-و ('-sh-w): evening twilight; ض-ح-و (ḍ-ḥ-w): morning sunlight; relativity of perceived earthly time.

ayahs.meta_en: The Fleeting Perception of Earthly Span
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ع-ش-و ('-sh-w): evening twilight; ض-ح-و (ḍ-ḥ-w): morning sunlight; relativity of perceived earthly time.

english_translations.sahih_international: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
english_translations.pickthall: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: The Day they see it, (It will be) as if they had tarried but a single evening, or (at most till) the following morn!
english_translations.shakir: On the day that they see it, it will be as though they had not tarried but the latter part of a day or the early part of it.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: On the day when they see it, it will seem to them as though they had only lived in the world for a morning and an afternoon.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: The Day they see it, (it will be) as if they had not tarried (in this world) except an afternoon or a morning.
english_translations.arberry: It shall be as if; on the day they see it, they have but tarried for an evening, or its forenoon.
